process.title: Discovery Call
process.description: We dig into what you're actually trying to solve — not just what you're asking for. Free, no commitment.

process.title: Scope & Proposal
process.description: I document deliverables, timeline, and price in writing. You approve, we proceed. No surprises.

process.title: Data & Design
process.description: I map your data sources, design the architecture, and share wireframes for sign-off before building.

process.title: Build & Iterate
process.description: I build in milestones. You see progress every 2–3 days, give feedback, and we adjust as we go.

process.title: Test & Validate
process.description: Stress tests against edge cases, dataset sizes, and refresh failures. Production-grade, not prototype-grade.

process.title: Delivery + Handover
process.description: Walkthrough call, recorded video tutorial, and full documentation. You and your team can actually run it.

process.title: 30-Day Support
process.description: Free bug fixes, tweaks, and questions for 30 days post-delivery. After that, optional retainer.

whyMe.title: Production-grade, not prototype-grade
whyMe.description: Every deliverable is documented, error-handled, and built to outlive the person who made it. If your team can't run it after I leave, I haven't done my job.

whyMe.title: Fast turnaround without compromise
whyMe.description: Most dashboards ship in 5–10 days. Full systems in 10–14. I don't pad timelines — I just don't quote what I can't deliver.

whyMe.title: NDA-friendly, data-confidential
whyMe.description: I sign NDAs, use anonymized datasets when possible, and treat your data like my own. No sub-contractors, no outsourcing — I build everything myself.

whyMe.title: Built to scale, not break
whyMe.description: Power Query, modular structures, named ranges, version-controlled. When your data grows 10x, your tools shouldn't crack.

whyMe.title: Responsive, available, human
whyMe.description: Replies under 4 hours during business days. Weekly check-ins. No ghosting, no surprises, no excuses.

whyMe.title: 100% delivery rate
whyMe.description: Every project I've taken on has shipped on spec. I'd rather decline work than over-promise.

pricing.note: Pricing is indicative. Final quote depends on scope, complexity, and timeline. Every project gets a written proposal before work begins.

faqs.q: How do you usually price projects?
faqs.a: Fixed price by scope, not hourly. After a 30-min discovery call I send a written proposal with deliverables, timeline, and price. You approve before any work starts.
Templates and data cleaning: 2–5 days. Dashboards: 5–10 days. Full systems and financial models: 7–14 days. Rush delivery available at +25%.
Yes, always — for any client who requests it. Your data, business logic, and methodologies stay confidential. I work alone, so there are no sub-contractors involved.

faqs.q: What happens if I need changes after delivery?
faqs.a: Every project includes 14–60 days of free post-delivery support (depending on tier) — bug fixes, small tweaks, and questions. After that, an optional retainer covers ongoing changes.

faqs.q: Can my team actually maintain what you build?
faqs.a: Yes — that's the standard I build to. Every project includes documentation, a recorded video walkthrough, and a handover call. If your team can't run it without me, I haven't done my job.

faqs.q: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.a: Most of my work is with clients in the US, UK, UAE, and Singapore. I work in your timezone for calls, deliver in your currency, and have invoicing set up for international payments.

faqs.q: What if my data is really messy?
faqs.a: That's literally what I do. Power Query was built for exactly this. Send a sample and I'll tell you on the discovery call what's salvageable and what we need to redesign.

faqs.q: Can you upgrade an existing spreadsheet instead of starting fresh?
faqs.a: Often — but not always. I'll review what you have and recommend honestly. Sometimes rebuilding is cheaper than patching a broken foundation.
